strings.自称伊比利亚王室海军将领后裔、失落的贵族——德·托莱多家族成员，在伊比利亚各地招: Claiming to be a descendant of an Iberian Royal Navy admiral and a member of the fallen noble house de Toledo, she has gathered many supporters throughout Iberia. However, her account of her past differs substantially from the Inquisition’s records, so HR registered her occupation as freelance when updating her file. De Toledo joined Rhodes Island on Irene’s recommendation. Her eloquence and knowledge of Iberia are sufficient to assist the operators at the Iberian office with their everyday work.

strings.虎狼丸，本班学生结城理的同伴，受到班级成员一致认可，特别登记为班级荣誉学生。\n:
Koromaru is a companion of Makoto Yuki, a student in this class. With the unanimous approval of the class, he has been specially registered as an honorary student.
According to his companions, Koromaru is a Perro beastkin. The people of Laterano rarely encounter a beastkin as willing to spend extended periods with people, and his intelligence and sensitivity have left a deep impression on many teachers and students. Aegis is particularly close to Koromaru: she understands his barks and helps him communicate with others. Koromaru quickly settled into the class and showed an interest in board games. His enthusiastic attendance at a friendly class tournament earned him the nickname “Koromaru, the bringer of victory.”

strings.由艾露猫政宗和牙猎犬义经组成的罗德岛隐秘队，命名来自他们在家乡炎火村隶属的编制—:
Rhodes Island Recon consists of the Palico Masamune and the Palamute Yoshitsune. Its name comes from the “Meowcenaries” unit they belonged to in their home village of Kamura. Both had professional training in reconnaissance and material gathering and spent a long time honing their skills in the Bubble Kingdom, so they quickly proved invaluable on missions after joining Rhodes Island. They want to find a way home, but are also enthusiastic about exploring Terra, and have adapted fairly well to life here.
The lively, friendly Masamune quickly became a celebrity among the operators: many requested assignments with him just to see the adorable talking “cloud beast.” Even the formerly aloof Yoshitsune has made friends with many operators who share his enthusiasm for combat.

strings.埃癸斯，1102年3月于中庭公证所登记为第三类驻留人员，根据拉特兰公民权利章程附:
Aegis registered as a Category III resident at the Atrium Notarial Hall in 1102/3. Under Article 36 of the appendix to the Lateran Citizens’ Charter and Article 5, Chapter 2 of the Regulations on the Administration of Entrants, she was admitted to Saint Marso Comprehensive School.
Teacher’s comments: Aegis is bright and eager to learn, conscientious and meticulous, responsible, and demanding of herself. She has achieved excellent results in the firearm-like armaments curriculum. We hope she will open up and try more group activities, enjoying a fulfilling school life alongside her academic progress.

strings.通讯技术工程师，其研究成果已应用于雷姆必拓远程通讯系统。现加入罗德岛工程部，为罗: A communications engineer whose research has been applied to Rim Billiton’s long-distance communications system. Now a member of Rhodes Island’s Engineering Department, Timeslot provides technical support for long-distance communications at Rhodes Island bases.

strings.岳羽由加莉，1102年3月于中庭公证所登记为第三类驻留人员，根据拉特兰公民权利章:
Yukari Takeba registered as a Category III resident at the Atrium Notarial Hall in 1102/3. Under Article 36 of the appendix to the Lateran Citizens’ Charter and Article 5, Chapter 2 of the Regulations on the Administration of Entrants, she was admitted to Saint Marso Comprehensive School.
Teacher’s comments: Yukari Takeba is intelligent and friendly, gentle and cheerful, a good communicator, and strongly independent. Her archery left a deep impression on her instructors in the firearm-like armaments curriculum. We hope that, when facing difficulties, she will also accept help from teachers and classmates, working with everyone to build a warm, harmonious class that supports one another.

strings.行动预备组A6成员，在本人意愿下变更为近卫干员，并展现出极强的近身搏斗和使用重型:
A member of Op Reserve A6 who transferred to a Guard role at her own request, displaying exceptional talent for close-quarters combat and heavy melee weapons. Besides A6’s routine assignments, she often volunteers for field missions into dangerous areas.
Everyone says that Catapult, once so fond of slacking off and playing tricks, has completely changed. She offers no comment on this assessment.

strings.安洁莉娜，服务于罗德岛的资深信使，足迹遍布迄今为止已知的大多数国家。同时，她也作: Angelina is a veteran messenger serving Rhodes Island whose travels have taken her to most countries known to date. She also supports Rhodes Island as an experienced Caster operator, making use of her distinctive Originium Arts.

strings.结城理，1102年3月于中庭公证所登记为拉特兰公民亲属，根据拉特兰公民权利章程附:
Makoto Yuki registered as a relative of a Lateran citizen at the Atrium Notarial Hall in 1102/3. Under Article 34 of the appendix to the Lateran Citizens’ Charter, he was admitted to Saint Marso Comprehensive School.
Teacher’s comments: Makoto Yuki is calm and composed, gets along well with his classmates, respects his teachers, and takes an active part in community activities. His volunteer work has earned unanimous praise. We hope he will keep up his efforts and continue to reach new heights.

strings.来自雷姆必拓大涌泉镇的珊比，前来罗德岛接受矿石病治疗，并经由干员安洁莉娜的推荐，: Thumpy, from Great Geyser Town in Rim Billiton, came to Rhodes Island for Oripathy treatment. On Angelina’s recommendation and at her own request, she joined the Field Operations Department to assist Rhodes Island as a Defender operator.

strings.行动预备组A6的队长，罗德岛人事部办公室年度人物，舰内时尚杂志《Orchid》创: Captain of Op Reserve A6, Rhodes Island HR office employee of the year, and founder of the onboard fashion magazine Orchid. At her own request, she has transferred to a Sniper role. While retaining her battlefield support capabilities, she has made considerable progress on the offensive front. She also frequently takes the initiative to offer constructive suggestions during missions.

strings.梅里塔，米诺斯牧驮人，携驮兽与罗德岛达成合作。梅里塔本人负责为罗德岛的经济动物养: Merita, a herdbeast herder from Minos, has entered into a partnership with Rhodes Island together with her herdbeasts. Merita provides guidance and assistance for Rhodes Island’s livestock farming operations, while the herdbeasts also provide pack transport and other services.

strings.经乌萨斯中央执行委员会决议，奥尔佳·达尼洛夫娜·特里波列娃在受到豁免之后，进入外: By resolution of the Ursus Central Executive Committee, Olga Danilovna Tripoleva received a pardon and took up a position in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Later, on the recommendation of members of the Ursus Student Self-Governing Group, she came to Rhodes Island to conduct liaison work on behalf of Saint Gryphonsburg.

strings.卡莱朵，卡兹戴尔镜匠。经罗德岛驻卡兹戴尔办事处干员推荐，与罗德岛达成合作，负责罗: Caleido is a mirror artisan from Kazdel. On the recommendation of operators at Rhodes Island’s Kazdel office, she entered into a partnership with Rhodes Island to refurbish and supply mirrors for its dormitories. Until she returns to Kazdel, she will also assist with forging work at Rhodes Island.

strings.塔露拉，感染者反抗组织“整合运动”的创始者暨前领导人。曾带领整合运动多次与迫害感: Talulah is the founder and former leader of Reunion, an organization resisting the persecution of the Infected. She led Reunion in numerous battles against forces of the Ursus Empire that persecuted the Infected. After years of growth, Reunion brought together many Infected and ordinary citizens and became a key force in the Saint Gryphonsburg revolution. After the revolution, Talulah voluntarily left Reunion. On Ch’en’s recommendation, she is now receiving Oripathy treatment at Rhodes Island.

strings.国度，以乌萨斯皇帝内卫形式现身的坍缩体，已确认不对任何乌萨斯官方机构负责，且不像: Territory is a Collapsal entity that manifests in the form of an Emperor’s Blade of Ursus. It has been confirmed to answer to no official Ursus institution and, unlike other Emperor’s Blades, is not controlled by the will of Ursus. It appeared of its own accord at Rhodes Island’s Saint Gryphonsburg office after the incident there. Following an assessment, it is now housed at Rhodes Island’s headquarters.

strings.冻河，本名费奥多尔·弗拉基米罗维奇·■■■■，其余客观履历缺失。: Toska, real name Fyodor Vladimirovich ■■■■. No other verifiable background information is available.
